scope: Read-only parser, consumer, shipped-asset, and live-memory correlation for waypoint event and bitfield fields.

wp_wpse.note: This alternate syntax overwrites the same two code words used by the second and third wp_event values.

event_scalar.behavior: waypoint +0x84 is a multiplicative factor in the normal AI pass-score result

event_codes.behavior: when waypoint +0x134 equals 1, the signed integer at +0x138 replaces the normal computed look-ahead/pass-score threshold; subsequent event-code-1 nodes also select a global fallback value

bitfields.behavior: No direct primary-code consumer was identified in this pass; the field remains semantically unresolved.

monza_asset.bitfield_one_correlation: Exactly the 24 grid-selector and 12 pit-team-selector pseudo-nodes on this asset; this is asset-local correlation, not a universal flag definition.

live_memory.adapter_rule: Only values_by_slot[0] is evidence because runtime-read was rebased from its vehicle adapter.

limitations: The visible or behavioral effect of Monza event code pair (1,18) was not isolated during this race.
The bitfield-one placement-selector correlation is not generalized across tracks.
No game memory, game file, or game input was changed.
